name: HRIS Backend
description:
HRIS PT Sentra Karya Digital - backend API tests (PRD section 81-88).

How to use:
1. npm run dev (server on http://localhost:3000)
2. Import this collection + the matching environment
3. Run folder 00 Setup first; each role folder logs in its own account.

Sessions are cookie based (Supabase SSR), so Postman's cookie jar keeps the
session between requests. Unauthorized requests remove the Cookie header in a
pre-request script instead of relying on a second collection.

item.name: Employee updates own phone and address
Check out without check in (negative, run before check-in)

exec: pm.test('201 Created or already checked in', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201, 409]));
pm.test('status is present or late', () => pm.expect(body.data ? body.data.status : 'present').to.be.oneOf(['present', 'late']));

item.name: Submit leave with end before start (negative)

exec: pm.test('status rejected or already reviewed', () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
